_about: Camera angles for the twin-speaker screen room (void-pair). Framed to the rule of thirds with frame_check.py (no guessing); cameras are level and reframed with lens shift so verticals stay vertical. multicam.mjs renders them side by side, in this order. 'cones' approved by Robert as perfect on 2026-11-12.

angles.name: three-quarter
angles._framing: both speakers whole and facing the camera; right speaker's mid and tweeter on the lower-right thirds crossing, left speaker on the lower-left; beams fill the upper two thirds

angles.name: cones
angles._framing: the two woofers on the left third line at its upper and lower crossings, mid and tweeter on the right third

angles.name: close-low
angles._framing: one speaker, front facing, woofers on the left third line, cabinet centred on the lower third; the screen fills the upper right
